seo.title: How to Buy
seo.description: Registering, bidding in the showroom, online, by telephone or absentee, paying and collecting.

hero.title: A guide to buying at auction.
hero.text: Whether it is your first auction or your hundredth, here is a guide to registering, placing a bid and what happens after the sale.

photo.alt: A specialist handling a silver object, close up, in warm directional light

register.title: Register to bid
register.text: Registration takes two steps. You need a paddle number before you can bid.
register.buttonLabel: Sign in or create an account

steps.title: Create an account
steps.body: Sign up online and confirm your account using the email we send you. If it doesn’t arrive, check your spam folder.

steps.title: Register for the sale
steps.body: Choose “Register to bid” on the auction you are interested in and sign in with your account.

steps.title: Receive your paddle number
steps.body: Once your registration is approved, we email you a paddle number. You need it to bid. You can also register in person.

ways.title: Four ways to bid

items.title: In the saleroom
items.body: Join us at our Chelsea saleroom and bid in person.

photo.alt: Bidders in the saleroom during a sale

items.title: Online
items.body: Bid in real time through our online bidding platform.

photo.alt: A lot being viewed on the online bidding platform

items.title: By telephone
items.body: A member of our team will call you during the sale and bid on your behalf.

photo.alt: A specialist taking a telephone bid

items.title: Absentee bid
items.body: Tell us the maximum amount you are willing to bid and we will bid on your behalf.

ways.note: To arrange a telephone or absentee bid, email {email} or call {phone}.

payment.title: After the sale
payment.text: Payment is due by the end of the fourteenth calendar day after the auction.

collection.title: Collection and shipping
collection.text: Items not collected, or arranged for shipping, within fourteen days incur storage charges. Please note, we do not offer in-house shipping, except for small items which will incur a fee.
